//! @generated — modul `pemanggil`. Satu facade tanpa state: layout → draw list
//! → renderer. Tidak pernah memiliki renderer, sehingga tidak ada siklus
//! ketergantungan dengan `app`.

pub mod layout;
pub mod resolve;

pub use layout::Layout;

use crate::component::{Component, Kind, Node, NodeId, ShapeKind, State, WidgetKind};
use crate::core::{Align, Color, Point, Rect, Size};
use crate::renderer::{DrawCmd, DrawList, RenderError, Renderer};

pub struct Caller;

impl Caller {
    pub fn layout(component: &Component, viewport: Size) -> Layout {
        layout::compute(component, viewport)
    }

    pub fn hit_test(layout: &Layout, point: Point) -> Option<NodeId> {
        layout::hit_test(layout, point)
    }

    pub fn draw_list(component: &Component, layout: &Layout, state: &State) -> DrawList {
        let mut list = DrawList::default();
        for root in &component.root {
            if root.visible {
                emit_node(root, component, layout, state, &mut list);
            }
        }
        list
    }

    /// Render satu frame lengkap. Backend dipinjam hanya selama pemanggilan.
    pub fn render(
        renderer: &mut dyn Renderer,
        component: &Component,
        state: &State,
        viewport: Size,
    ) -> Result<crate::core::Frame, RenderError> {
        let layout = Self::layout(component, viewport);
        let list = Self::draw_list(component, &layout, state);
        renderer.render(&list, viewport.clamped())
    }
}

fn emit_node(node: &Node, component: &Component, layout: &Layout, state: &State, list: &mut DrawList) {
    let Some(rect) = layout.get(node.id) else {
        return;
    };
    let opacity = node.style.effective_opacity();
    let hovered = state.is_hovered(node.id);
    let pressed = state.is_pressed(node.id);

    if let Some(bytes) = resolve::image_bytes(node.style.fill.as_ref(), &component.assets) {
        list.push(DrawCmd::Image {
            rect,
            bytes,
        });
    } else if let Some(fill) = resolve::fill_color(node.style.fill.as_ref()) {
        let fill = highlight(fill, hovered, pressed);
        list.push(DrawCmd::Rect {
            rect,
            fill,
            radius: node.style.corner_radius,
            opacity,
        });
    }

    if let Some(stroke) = resolve::fill_color(node.style.stroke.as_ref()) {
        list.push(DrawCmd::StrokeRect {
            rect,
            stroke,
            width: node.style.stroke_width.max(1.0),
            radius: node.style.corner_radius,
        });
    }

    match &node.kind {
        Kind::Shape(ShapeKind::Ellipse) => {
            if let Some(fill) = resolve::fill_color(node.style.fill.as_ref()) {
                list.push(DrawCmd::Ellipse {
                    rect,
                    fill,
                    opacity,
                });
            } else {
                list.push(DrawCmd::Ellipse {
                    rect,
                    fill: Color::new(200, 200, 200, 255),
                    opacity,
                });
            }
        }
        Kind::Shape(ShapeKind::Line) => list.push(DrawCmd::Line {
            from: rect.origin,
            to: Point::new(rect.right(), rect.bottom()),
            stroke: resolve::fill_color(node.style.stroke.as_ref()).unwrap_or(Color::BLACK),
            width: node.style.stroke_width.max(1.0),
        }),
        Kind::Shape(ShapeKind::Vector | ShapeKind::Rectangle) => {}
        Kind::Frame(_) => {}
        Kind::Image { .. } => {}
        Kind::Text(spec) => list.push(DrawCmd::Text {
            rect,
            text: resolve::text(&spec.text, state),
            size: spec.font_size,
            color: spec.color,
            bold: spec.bold,
            align: spec.align,
        }),
        Kind::Widget(spec) => {
            emit_widget(spec, rect, state, list);
        }
    }

    for child in &node.children {
        if child.visible {
            emit_node(child, component, layout, state, list);
        }
    }
}

fn emit_widget(spec: &crate::component::WidgetSpec, rect: Rect, state: &State, list: &mut DrawList) {
    let label = resolve::widget_label(spec, state);
    let binding = spec.binding.as_deref();
    let text_color = Color::new(30, 34, 40, 255);
    let accent = Color::new(43, 110, 240, 255);

    match &spec.kind {
        WidgetKind::Checkbox | WidgetKind::RadioButton => {
            let box_rect = Rect::new(rect.left(), rect.top() + rect.size.height * 0.2, rect.size.height * 0.6, rect.size.height * 0.6);
            list.push(DrawCmd::StrokeRect {
                rect: box_rect,
                stroke: text_color,
                width: 1.5,
                radius: if matches!(spec.kind, WidgetKind::RadioButton) { box_rect.size.height / 2.0 } else { 3.0 },
            });
            if binding.is_some_and(|key| state.bool(key, false)) {
                list.push(DrawCmd::Rect {
                    rect: box_rect.shrink(4.0),
                    fill: accent,
                    radius: 2.0,
                    opacity: 1.0,
                });
            }
            list.push(DrawCmd::Text {
                rect: Rect::new(rect.left() + rect.size.height * 0.8, rect.top(), rect.size.width - rect.size.height * 0.8, rect.size.height),
                text: label,
                size: 14.0,
                color: text_color,
                bold: false,
                align: Align::Start,
            });
        }
        WidgetKind::Switch => {
            let track = Rect::new(rect.left(), rect.top() + rect.size.height * 0.25, rect.size.width, rect.size.height * 0.5);
            let on = binding.is_some_and(|key| state.bool(key, false));
            list.push(DrawCmd::Rect {
                rect: track,
                fill: if on { accent } else { Color::new(190, 195, 200, 255) },
                radius: track.size.height / 2.0,
                opacity: 1.0,
            });
            let knob_size = track.size.height - 4.0;
            let knob_x = if on { track.right() - knob_size - 2.0 } else { track.left() + 2.0 };
            list.push(DrawCmd::Ellipse {
                rect: Rect::new(knob_x, track.top() + 2.0, knob_size, knob_size),
                fill: Color::WHITE,
                opacity: 1.0,
            });
        }
        WidgetKind::Slider | WidgetKind::ProgressBar => {
            let track = Rect::new(rect.left(), rect.top() + rect.size.height * 0.4, rect.size.width, rect.size.height * 0.2);
            list.push(DrawCmd::Rect {
                rect: track,
                fill: Color::new(215, 220, 226, 255),
                radius: track.size.height / 2.0,
                opacity: 1.0,
            });
            let value = binding
                .and_then(|key| state.get(key))
                .and_then(|value| match value {
                    crate::component::Value::Number(number) => Some(*number),
                    _ => None,
                })
                .unwrap_or(0.5)
                .clamp(0.0, 1.0);
            list.push(DrawCmd::Rect {
                rect: Rect::new(track.left(), track.top(), track.size.width * value, track.size.height),
                fill: accent,
                radius: track.size.height / 2.0,
                opacity: 1.0,
            });
        }
        WidgetKind::Dropdown | WidgetKind::ListBox | WidgetKind::Menu | WidgetKind::Tabs => {
            list.push(DrawCmd::StrokeRect {
                rect,
                stroke: Color::new(190, 195, 200, 255),
                width: 1.0,
                radius: 6.0,
            });
            list.push(DrawCmd::Text {
                rect: Rect::new(rect.left() + 8.0, rect.top(), rect.size.width - 24.0, rect.size.height),
                text: label,
                size: 14.0,
                color: text_color,
                bold: false,
                align: Align::Start,
            });
            list.push(DrawCmd::Text {
                rect: Rect::new(rect.right() - 20.0, rect.top(), 16.0, rect.size.height),
                text: "v".into(),
                size: 12.0,
                color: text_color,
                bold: false,
                align: Align::Center,
            });
        }
        WidgetKind::TextInput | WidgetKind::TextArea => {
            list.push(DrawCmd::StrokeRect {
                rect,
                stroke: Color::new(170, 178, 188, 255),
                width: 1.0,
                radius: 4.0,
            });
            list.push(DrawCmd::Text {
                rect: Rect::new(rect.left() + 8.0, rect.top(), rect.size.width - 16.0, rect.size.height),
                text: label,
                size: 14.0,
                color: text_color,
                bold: false,
                align: Align::Start,
            });
        }
        _ => {
            list.push(DrawCmd::Text {
                rect,
                text: label,
                size: 14.0,
                color: text_color,
                bold: matches!(spec.kind, WidgetKind::Button),
                align: Align::Center,
            });
        }
    }
}

/// Helpers lokal supaya caller tidak perlu mengimpor core::Rect::shrink.
trait RectExt {
    fn shrink(self, amount: f32) -> Self;
}

impl RectExt for Rect {
    fn shrink(self, amount: f32) -> Self {
        let half = amount.max(0.0) / 2.0;
        Rect::new(
            self.left() + half,
            self.top() + half,
            (self.size.width - amount).max(0.0),
            (self.size.height - amount).max(0.0),
        )
    }
}

fn highlight(color: Color, hovered: bool, pressed: bool) -> Color {
    let delta = if pressed { -18i16 } else if hovered { 14i16 } else { 0 };
    let channel = |value: u8| (i16::from(value) + delta).clamp(0, 255) as u8;
    Color::new(channel(color.r), channel(color.g), channel(color.b), color.a)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn draw_list_contains_text_command() {
        let component = crate::design::build();
        let layout = Caller::layout(&component, component.design_size);
        let list = Caller::draw_list(&component, &layout, &State::new());
        assert!(!list.commands.is_empty());
        assert!(list.commands.iter().any(|cmd| matches!(cmd, DrawCmd::Text { .. })));
    }
}
